LanguageData.RimatomicsActivate.discoveredLetterText:
You open a connection to the probe and a recorded message starts to play.

Someone with the slimy demeanour of a used bionics salesman claims to represent a trading faction known as "Rimatomics".

As he makes his sales pitch, exabytes of data begin flooding into the console. He explains that he's sending blueprints to construct a Rimatomics research bench, which you can use to purchase plans for some of their technology or request trade ships.

Check the Rimatomics tab in the architect menu.
